newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air to take 36 pct stake in Lauda Air.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air to take 36 pct stake in Lauda Air.

text.p: Austrian Airlines said on Wednesday it would acquire a 36 percent stake in competitor Lauda Air.
The annoucement came shortly after German flag carrier Lufthansa said it would cut its stake in Lauda Air to 20 percent from 39.7 percent and sell its share package to Austrian Air.
"Austrian Airlines will take on 36 percent of the voting rights and strategic control of Lauda Air," supervisory board chief Rudolf Streicher told a news conference.
He said Lauda Air's founder and current majority owner, ex-racing driver Niki Lauda, would retain 30 percent of the voting rights.
"This is a good solution for the Austrian aviation industry," Streicher said, adding it would help the group to weather the increasingly tough competition in Europe's skies.
No financial details of the deal, which is subject to regulatory clearance, were immediately available. -- Vienna newsroom +431 53112 274
